styles.notes: Astro supports two scoped style strategies: attribute-based (data-astro-cid-{hash}) and class-based (astro-{hash} with :where() selectors). Strategy depends on scopedStyleStrategy in astro.config.

images.notes: /_astro/ images may be rewritten through hosting CDNs (e.g., /.netlify/images?url=_astro%2F...). Astro 6+ has stable responsive images via layout prop on Image/Picture components.

animations.notes: Astro supports View Transitions API via ClientRouter component. DOM attributes: data-astro-transition-scope, data-astro-transition-persist, data-astro-transition-fallback, data-astro-rerun, data-astro-reload, data-astro-exec.

quirks.description: Astro outputs the cleanest semantic HTML of any framework. Minimal wrapper divs.
quirks.workaround: Use body > * as primary selector. Section discovery should work with minimal filtering.

quirks.description: <astro-island> wraps interactive components with client:* directives. Most Astro pages ship zero islands — content is fully static HTML.
quirks.workaround: Wait for page load + idle before extracting interactive island content. Islands are inside sections, not sections themselves.

quirks.description: A single Astro page can contain islands from React, Vue, Svelte. Starlight (Astro docs theme) uses Svelte internally, triggering false Svelte detection.
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles from all islands regardless of underlying framework. Ignore framework-specific class hashes.

quirks.description: Most Astro pages ship zero JavaScript. Content is fully static HTML with scoped CSS. Zero astro-island elements found across 4 production sites tested.
quirks.workaround: No hydration wait needed for pages without astro-island elements. Extract directly from initial HTML.

quirks.description: In Astro 5+, ViewTransitions was renamed to ClientRouter. DOM uses data-astro-transition-scope, data-astro-transition-persist, data-astro-exec attributes. <meta name='view-transition'> is NOT reliably present.
quirks.workaround: Check for data-astro-transition-scope on elements. Check for data-astro-exec on scripts.

quirks.description: Astro supports two scoped style strategies: attribute-based (data-astro-cid-{hash}) and class-based (astro-{hash} with :where() selectors). docs.astro.build uses class-based; astro.build uses attribute-based.
quirks.workaround: Detect both patterns. Strip classes matching /^astro-[a-z0-9]+$/ AND attributes matching /^data-astro-cid-/ from section labels.

quirks.description: Astro 5+ supports server:defer directive creating server islands that load asynchronously after initial render. Initial HTML has script placeholder and slot fallback.
quirks.workaround: Wait for server island content to load before extracting. Check for empty slot[name='fallback'] elements.

quirks.description: /_astro/ images may be routed through hosting CDNs (Netlify: /.netlify/images?url=_astro%2F...). The pattern appears URL-encoded.
quirks.workaround: Match both direct /_astro/ paths and URL-encoded variants in CDN query strings.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
